head: working-tree
subject: gRPC owned unary response message
change: UnaryResponseOptions gains owned_message backed by grpc.OwnedResponseMessage, prefix-reserved storage that a handler serializes into directly. An identity unary response hands that exact allocation to the HTTP/2 writer, removing the framed staging copy of the whole response; compressed responses still allocate a separate framed buffer, and the borrowed message field keeps the existing staging path. The caller's deferred deinit is safe because successful submission consumes the storage.

tests.unit: src/grpc/runtime_tests.zig runs a real h2c server that fills an OwnedResponseMessage payload, submits it through writeUnary, and verifies the client receives the exact payload while the caller's message no longer holds storage.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='owned unary response' --summary all

notes: The borrowed message path remains the default and still stages prefix plus payload. Only callers that serialize into OwnedResponseMessage.payload() avoid the response-sized copy, matching the existing client-side owned-write API. A response with both message and owned_message is rejected as InvalidMessageCount.
